title: Very Disappointing
text: Very Disappointing. I really wanted and needed a pepper grinder and I still need one. This little gadget only holds a very little bit of peppercorns. It will be fine for table use only as you have to work very hard to get a little bit of pepper out. As for spices, I have no idea what they thought is going to go into this small diameter tube as far as spices go. You might be able to force some fennel seed in there, but certainly not much else. Very disappointing.

description: Combining ultimate convenience with a unique/modern design has been the ultimate goal of the Cuisinart spice mill. This combination pepper Grinder/salt shaker/spice pen is as user friendly as it is sleek. Simply twist the chamber to open. Once open, you can pour your salt, pepper, or spice into the 40Ml chamber. Then reconnect the chamber. Now, just press the soft, rubberized pump button to dispense your chosen spices on whatever you're cooking or about to eat. This one-handed spice grinding & dispensing tool can be taken with you anywhere & stored in a drawer or with your spices.
